{"translations": ["Brought three bags, all of the best from the back mountain."]}
{"translations": ["A crack appeared in the barrier again last night, and Elder Qin stayed up all night."]}

{"translations": ["Hurry, lift it up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills."]}
{"translations": ["Wanqi Jing rushed into the main hall carrying the unconscious woman, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Chou (qiú) Shuang."]}
{"translations": ["The injury isn't serious, it's just that the spiritual power is exhausted. Just feed them a Spirit Recovery Pill."]}

translations.1: In the early morning, the mist outside the mountain gate had not yet dispersed.
translations.10: Senior Sister Zeng, Elder Qin asked you to go to the barrier area; Senior Brother Wanqi and I are here.
translations.11: Okay. Once Miss Chou wakes up, come call me immediately.
translations.12: 万俟靖 scratched his head, then turned around and ran towards the foot of the mountain.
translations.13: Xie Xuanli stood at the temple entrance; his sword had not yet left its scabbard, yet the lamplight flickered for a moment.
translations.14: Elder Qin, I hope you have been well. I am here on the Pavilion Master's orders to collect thirty percent of the spirit stones.
translations.15: Thirty percent? Spirit stones were painstakingly saved by the sect, when would it be the turn of outsiders to take them?
translations.16: The barrier is already cracked; it is not safe to keep the spirit stones in your hands. I will come again in three days.
translations.17: Xie Xuan gave a cold laugh, turned around, and walked away without even looking back.
translations.18: If I say three days, it will be three days; I never break my word.
translations.19: Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at the unconscious Chou Shuang on the couch.
translations.2: Yun Zhou, you are finally back. Did you bring enough spirit stones?
translations.20: Elder, let me go guard the barrier. Miss Chou has Lechuan to look after her, so I can leave.
translations.21: Finally, [he] nodded and took out a jade talisman from [his] sleeve.
translations.22: This is the Array Eye Command. Only by defending it can you truly defend your Dao.
translations.23: Le Chuan stuffed the medicine pouch into Yun Zhou's arms, and then whispered a few more instructions.
translations.24: At the mountain gate, Wanqi Jing handed over a straw raincoat.
translations.25: Thank you, Senior Brother Wanqi. Miss Chou has woken up; please convey my thanks to her.
translations.26: Shan Yunzhou nodded and kept the Array Eye Command close to his person.
translations.27: In the hall, Chou Shuang slowly opened her eyes.
translations.28: It's good that you're awake. You've been unconscious all day, don't move around too much ▼
translations.29: Chou Shuang struggled to sit up, looking out at the cracked sky through the window.
translations.3: Brought three bags, all of the best from the back mountain.
translations.30: Unnoticed, the letter in the sleeve bore Jie Xuan's seal.
translations.4: A crack appeared in the barrier again last night, and Elder Qin stayed up all night.
translations.5: Before the words had even finished falling, Wanqi Jing rushed up from the bottom of the mountain.
translations.6: Panting, he said, a young woman was lying by the roadside at the foot of the mountain
translations.7: Hurry, lift it up. Ruoshui, go get the healing pills.
translations.8: Wanqi Jing rushed into the main hall carrying the unconscious woman, the iron plaque at his waist engraved with: Chou (qiú) Shuang.
translations.9: The injury isn't serious, it's just that the spiritual power is exhausted. Just feed them a Spirit Recovery Pill.
